scope: Typed AI output parsing, syntax-only repair, immutable NluContext and bounded history; no schema migration or formal plan version.
testModeReason: Shared AI DTO validation, client/server import boundaries, provider usage and guarded request budgets change; affected selection is unavailable. Full discovered product regression plus all six fixtures and five isolated negative controls are required.

engineeringRegression.dedicatedCardCommand: npm run test -- json-parser schemas context-manager json-repair
engineeringRegression.discovery: vitest list --json; exact file/fullName equality, no skipped or zero tests

cases.command: npm run test -- json-parser schemas context-manager json-repair
cases.expected: Remove BOM, outer whitespace and paired fences without removing JSON content; empty, unpaired and injected text are rejected safely.

cases.command: npm run test -- json-parser schemas context-manager json-repair
cases.expected: Parse the registered typed output in memory; syntax failures are INVALID_JSON, schema failures are SCHEMA_MISMATCH, public errors are 503 PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE; no raw values or stack in errors.

cases.command: npm run test -- json-parser schemas context-manager json-repair
cases.expected: Consume the frozen TravelRequirement v1, TravelPlanSummaryDraft v1 and all eight prompt schemas exactly; reject unknown keys, version drift, invalid enums/scalars/derived values/references and preserve the formal-plan write boundary.

cases.command: npm run test -- json-parser schemas context-manager json-repair
cases.expected: Use the active planner.repair_json through guardedJsonChat; restore only provable syntax/type formatting without changing values, bindings, identities, dates, coordinates, money, routes or sources; append the original and each repair attempt with exact versions and server duration; missing usage stays null.

cases.command: npm run test -- json-parser schemas context-manager json-repair
cases.expected: At most two repair calls; failed schema/semantic validation, fact fabrication, timeout/rate/cancellation and exhausted shared deadline/token/cost budget stop safely; every sent attempt is append-only with safe hashes and production rawOutput null; no plan or partial success writes.

cases.command: npm run test -- json-parser schemas context-manager json-repair
cases.expected: Build immutable typed history from owner-checked ChatMessage sequence, preserve required system rules and most recent user/assistant messages within maxMessages/maxChars; impossible limits return CONFIG_ERROR; exact server-injected NluContext keeps one clock, signal, identity, trace and budget.
Temporary removal of fence cleaning, schema validation, two-repair limit, fact preservation or system retention must fail the exact targeted assertion; restore bytes and rerun all six fixture groups.
